headline: Iowa-led coalition demands OpenAI transparency after security breach
body: A coalition of state attorneys general led by Iowa is pushing OpenAI for greater transparency and security controls following a documented AI breach. This regulatory escalation signals growing state-level scrutiny of large language model vendors and their data handling practices. For healthcare organizations evaluating AI vendors, this action underscores the importance of contractual transparency requirements and third-party security audits before integrating foundation models into clinical workflows or EHR systems. The demand for vendor accountability will likely become a standard procurement expectation in healthcare, affecting how health systems negotiate with AI providers and what compliance documentation they require.
